decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and actively marketed with a dedicated page, the option value remains high while market uncertainty is unresolved and carrying costs are low.
As a modular product line close to the core business, it retains option value despite slightly higher complexity and carrying costs from multiple models.
Building on established capabilities and presented on its own page, it is a low-cost option worth keeping while demand uncertainty persists.

Though only mentioned rather than given a dedicated page, the miniaturized LiDAR is close to established competencies and may still hold option value, but lower visibility suggests a somewhat higher chance of being pruned.
